# BiharResult.Live

> Bihar-focused education and exam updates: results, admit cards, jobs, answer keys, syllabus, university notices, and Bihar Board announcements.

## About
- Site: https://biharresult.live/
- Region focus: Bihar, India
- Language: English + Hindi (Hinglish usage in explainer content)
- Topic focus: Government exam notifications, board results, admission and admit card updates.

## Canonical Sections
- Home: https://biharresult.live/
- Latest Result: https://biharresult.live/latest-result.html
- Admit Card: https://biharresult.live/admit-card.html
- Latest Jobs: https://biharresult.live/latest-jobs.html
- Bihar Board: https://biharresult.live/bihar-board.html

- Syllabus: https://biharresult.live/syllabus.html
- University: https://biharresult.live/university.html
